body_text:
Principle of mathematical induction. Let $P(n)$ be a predicate on
$\mathbb{N}$. If $P(0)$ holds and, for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$,
$P(n)$ implies $P(n+1)$, then $P(n)$ holds for every natural
number $n$. The proof applies the Peano induction axiom to the set
$A=\{n\in\mathbb{N}:P(n)\}$.
